responsibility: This header defines the text-art table subsystem: table_cell_content, dimension-sizing helpers, table placement data structures, and table_geometry for converting abstract table cells and spans into canvas coordinates. It declares the API for building partially populated or spanned cell grids with alignment, computing shared row/column requirements, rendering them to canvases with a chosen theme, and composing tables for larger diagnostic diagrams.
same_name_distinction: Declares the table-related data structures and APIs, including cell content, placements, sizing helpers, and geometry classes; unlike gcc/text-art/table.cc, it does not implement span placement, border painting, or layout passes.
